dedupeText: grungy medical x ray collage x ray skeleton grunge film strip tape distressed medical cyanotype the x ray plate acts as a window into the subject s internal anatomy the contrast between the warm cream background and the cold cyan x ray tones the tactile layering of tape and film strips over a clean studio photograph the heavy blocky title anchoring the top third of the composition combine a central medical element x ray scan with a distressed analog frame film tape and heavy eroded display typography for a gritty diagnostic aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A central human torso x-ray held by a person, framed within a distressed 400TX film border with masking tape accents and heavy, weathered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The x-ray plate acts as a window into the subject's internal anatomy.
The contrast between the warm, cream background and the cold, cyan x-ray tones.
The tactile layering of tape and film strips over a clean studio photograph.
The heavy, blocky title anchoring the top third of the composition.
coreInvariants: Cyan-blue glow of the x-ray bones
Black film strip border with white technical markings
Tan masking tape strips at the top and bottom edges
Distressed, eroded edges on large-scale lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A person holding a large x-ray plate occupies the central vertical axis, scaled to fill the frame from waist to shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing spine and ribcage within the dark x-ray plate.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the heavy top title, moves down the glowing spine, and rests on the handwritten tape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cream-colored studio background provides breathing room around the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream and off-white for the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the film border and x-ray background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric cyan and white for the glowing skeletal structure.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, saturated x-ray and the desaturated, bright background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and sans-serif mix
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky strokes with minimal counters
Eroded, stenciled, or weathered edges to simulate physical wear
Inconsistent baseline for secondary text to mimic hand-labeling
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' features a deep, angular notch
Letters in the main title overlap slightly to create a singular mass

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaid on background, partially obscured by tape

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy industrial display type paired with casual, raw handwriting.

preserve: Heavy weight of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the main title.
Mimics the casual labeling on the bottom tape.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person in a red shirt holding a large medical x-ray of a human torso against a cream studio wall. Frame the entire image with a black 35mm film strip border containing white text like '400TX'. Add strips of tan masking tape at the top and bottom edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a heavy, distressed slab-serif title in the top third. Add a handwritten marker-style caption onto the bottom piece of tape.

verificationChecks: Does the film border look authentic with technical markings?
Is the main title heavy and weathered?
Is the bottom text placed correctly on the tape?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the film border
Level of erosion on the display type
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the x-ray bones are clearly visible and glowing.
Verify the film border doesn't obscure the main subject.
Check that the tape looks like a physical overlay.
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the grunge texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central medical element (x-ray/scan) with a distressed analog frame (film/tape) and heavy, eroded display typography for a gritty, diagnostic aesthetic.
